The '''Talaos City Medallion''' was an honorary award that was typically bestowed upon the most upstanding citizens of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]'s [[Talaos City]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial forces]] on the world gave out the medallion to their most distinguished operatives.

==Behind the scenes==
The Talaos City Medallion appears in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a reputation trophy. It could be rewarded to players who completed certain Imperial bonus missions on the planet Makeb, and was introduced in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']], a [[2013]] digital expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]].
